complete_examples.text: Finally, by making the projection of the residual error vanish, a set of nonlinear ordinary differential equations is established and solved numerically.
The residual error of the Fokker–Planck–Kolmogorov equation is then derived by assuming the probability density function solution as the type of exponential polynomial with time-dependent variables.
